use: Illustrated promotional cover, not a gameplay screenshot
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a finished premium indie game cover for GameNight. Portrait 3:4 composition, ideally 1536x2048. Full bleed artwork, no frame. The supplied screenshot is a reference for the actual game's identity, not an image to copy or a screenshot to decorate. Reimagine it as beautiful authored key art. A striking clear silhouette and deliberate composition, carefully crafted materials and lighting, rich but controlled detail. A large beautifully designed title occupies the upper quarter, stays entirely inside safe margins and is legible at 180 pixels wide. No subtitle, badge, developer/publisher logos, watermark, UI, scores, or interface text. Do not imitate another game's branding. Title exactly 'BALLKICKERS'. Playful tactile 3D toy football in a compact packed stadium, orange versus cyan teams of charming round-headed stubby athletes, orange jersey player kicking an oversized black-and-white football toward camera, cyan challenger sliding behind, curved action arc and small turf chunks. Tiny cheering crowd, mint green striped pitch and goal behind. Sunny golden rimlight, vivid tangerine and turquoise. Bold rounded sporty cream typography with dark navy shadow. Exciting physical comedy, expressive friendly faces, miniature-diorama proportions matching reference. No realistic adult footballers.
review: Actual game rendered and inspected; generated master and final 360x480 cover visually reviewed. Promotional illustration, not gameplay.
